name: Ash-Scarred
text: It survived a wildfire or a burned village and came out tougher and angrier.

name: Broodmother
text: It guards a nest. Leave it and the region fills with its young; kill it and the threat ends.

addTrait.name: Spawn Brood
addTrait.text: Calls runts of its kind into every fight.

name: Caravan Raider
text: It has learned that wagons mean food, gold and soft prey. It haunts the trade roads.

name: Cult-Marked
text: A sigil burned into its hide binds it to a cult. It obeys their whispers and dies screaming their god's name.

addTrait.name: Death Curse
addTrait.text: When slain, curses its killer with bad luck for a day.

name: Elder
text: Left alone off-screen, it grew huge and cunning. Its lair has become a landmark.

name: Fog-Touched
text: It has lived too long in the mist and the mist has gotten into it. Scouts see it only when it is already close.

addTrait.name: Mist Cloak
addTrait.text: Hidden while in fog; its first strike from the mist hits harder.

name: Frostbitten
text: Rimed with ice from a hard winter, slow but nearly impossible to chill further.

name: Ghostcap-Dreaming
text: It ate pale mushrooms and half its body drifted into the spirit world. Blades pass through it as often as not.

addTrait.name: Half There
addTrait.text: Flickers in and out of sight and can pass through walls.

name: Ley-Drunk
text: It fed on a ley line until it glowed. Its blows crackle with wild magic and its corpse holds a ley crystal.

addTrait.name: Wild Surge
addTrait.text: Its attacks sometimes trigger a random magical burst.

name: Lich-Bound
text: Raised or claimed by the lich. It does not tire, does not fear, and carries its master's eyes.

addTrait.name: Master's Eyes
addTrait.text: The lich sees what it sees, so its sightings of the town help the siege.

name: of the Bloodtusk
text: Painted with the red tusk of Grukk's horde. It fights alongside the warband and flees to it when hurt.

name: of the Deep Dark
text: Bleached and blind from caves where no light reaches. It hunts by sound and is lost in sunlight.

addTrait.name: Blind Hunter
addTrait.text: Senses everything nearby in the dark but is weakened in daylight.

name: Plague-Ridden
text: Sick and spreading it. Heroes who fight it may bring the sickness home.

addTrait.name: Carrier
addTrait.text: Wounded foes may catch a disease that spreads in town.

name: Relic Hoarder
text: It sleeps on a pile of shiny things, among them a relic fragment that makes it stronger.

addTrait.name: Shard-Charged
addTrait.text: Gains one random minor magical power from its hoard.

name: Runt
text: The weakling of its brood, smaller and hungrier. Easy work for a fresh party.

name: Siege-Hardened
text: Bred or trained to break walls, it ignores arrows and throws itself at gates.

name: Starving
text: Hunger drove it out of the wilds toward the town's barns and herds.

name: the Unburied
text: It died out in the wilds and nobody buried it, so it got back up. A grim echo of what it was.

addTrait.name: Restless Dead
addTrait.text: Counts as undead and rises once more unless burned or blessed.

name: Warband Veteran
text: Scarred by a dozen raids and drilled to fight in a line.

name: Wardsalt-Burned
text: Scorched by a town's wards and still crawling back. It hates the walls and goes for them first.

addTrait.name: Ward-Hatred
addTrait.text: Attacks warded walls and gates before people.
